### Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMR)

How It Works

SiMa.ai powers AMRs with multimodal compute for simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), object detection, and path planning — all on a low-power edge platform.

Key Benefits

- 16-channel LiDAR input at 10 FPS for precise mapping
- 6-camera object detection at 30 FPS for safe navigation
- Low-power profile enabling fanless, compact mobile platforms

## Why Customers Choose SiMa.ai for Robotics

Purpose-built silicon and software for intelligent robotic systems — from autonomous mobile platforms to humanoid robots.

### Best-in-Class Performance per Watt

Industry-leading FPS with multimodal compute at the edge — enabling 8–10x improvement over incumbent GPU-based solutions.

### Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMR)

Multi-modal compute for SLAM, object detection, and path planning — all on a single low-power chip enabling fanless, compact mobile platforms.

### Humanoid and Collaborative Robots

Physical AI enables real-time perception and decision-making in humanoid robots and cobots, supporting safe human collaboration on the factory floor.

### SLAM and 3D Navigation

16-channel LiDAR input at 10 FPS combined with 6-camera object detection at 30 FPS — simultaneous localization and mapping at the edge.

### Conversational HMI

Run small language models like Gemma 3 locally on robot hardware — enabling natural language interfaces for operators without cloud connectivity.

### Stereo Depth and Sensor Fusion

LightStereo depth estimation at 333 FPS fused with LiDAR, radar, and IMU data — accurate real-time 3D perception for safe navigation in dynamic environments.
